scriptData.label: @effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
The arrow slams into your forehead at an angle, scouring your skull before glancing off. Like all head wounds, this one is a bleeder and your eyes fill with the blood pouring down your face!

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (1) and @Condition[Bleeding] (1). You also gain @Condition[Blinded] (2) which cannot be removed until the @Condition[Bleeding] Condition has been removed.

No Extraction is necessary.
